summary.text: Calvin R. "Cal" Musselman is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 4, which covers parts of Davis and Weber counties, and has served since January 2019. His official legislative profile lists his profession as real estate sales.

paragraphs.text: Musselman holds an Associate of Science degree.
He sits on the Senate Business and Labor Committee and the Senate Judiciary, Law Enforcement, and Criminal Justice Committee.
